boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Saint Xavier destinations for studying, gathering, recreation, reflection, food, and student work.

cards.entity_name: Mary Rita and Robert Stump Library
cards.title: Mary Rita and Robert Stump Library
cards.subtitle: Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Use the library as a named academic stop inside Warde; confirm its current access and services with library staff before planning a longer session.
cards.short_summary: A Warde Academic Center study destination.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU identifies the Mary Rita and Robert Stump Library as a component of the Warde Academic Center.
cards.access_notes: Located in Warde Academic Center; confirm visitor and building access directly with SXU.

cards.title: Wiseman Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University campus
cards.notes: Look for scheduled Student Life programming here, then use the lounge as a place to learn about campus involvement and housing resources.
cards.short_summary: A named lounge used for Student Life programming.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU's admitted-student program listed a Student Life on Campus session in Wiseman Student Lounge.
cards.source_title: Admitted Student Visit Day — Scarlet Track
cards.access_notes: Programming and access may vary; check with Student Life.

cards.title: Butler Reception Room
cards.subtitle: Saint Xavier University campus
cards.notes: Watch for resource-fair or department events assigned here; bring questions for the participating offices rather than assuming walk-in availability.
cards.short_summary: A named campus room used for student resource fairs.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU's admitted-student program listed a Student Resource Fair in the Butler Reception Room.
cards.source_title: Admitted Student Visit Day — Scarlet Track

cards.title: Shannon Center
cards.subtitle: Athletics, recreation, and campus events
cards.notes: Bring a current Cougar ID to use the recreation facilities, or check the athletics calendar for an appropriately scheduled campus event.
cards.short_summary: An 85,000-square-foot campus recreation and events facility.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU says the Shannon Center includes fitness, recreation, track, racquetball, group-exercise, meeting, and locker facilities.
cards.access_notes: SXU describes it as a private facility; patrons must present a current SXU ID and sign in.

cards.title: Urso Outdoor Sports Center
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Bruce R. Deaton Memorial Field
cards.notes: Use this as a landmark when attending a scheduled Cougar field event; respect athletic-team and facility access controls outside public events.
cards.short_summary: A field-side athletic facility with training and meeting space.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that the Urso Outdoor Sports Center is adjacent to Deaton Field and has a weight room, meeting room, and athletic training facility.
cards.access_notes: Athletic facilities may have restricted access; attend scheduled events or ask SXU staff.

cards.title: Bruce R. Deaton Memorial Field
cards.subtitle: Cougar football and soccer field
cards.notes: Check the Cougar schedule before going and use the field as the destination for a scheduled football or soccer event, not an unscheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: The campus field identified for Cougar football and soccer.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU states that Cougar football and soccer play at Bruce R. Deaton Memorial Field.
cards.access_notes: Field access is event and team-use dependent.

cards.title: McDonough Chapel
cards.subtitle: Mother of Mercy chapel
cards.notes: Use the published weekday private-prayer window for a quiet visit, or consult Campus Ministry’s calendar for current worship and reflection offerings.
cards.short_summary: A named chapel with private-prayer and worship use.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU says McDonough Chapel is open for private prayer Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
cards.access_notes: SXU lists private prayer Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.; worship times vary.

cards.title: Visual Arts Center
cards.subtitle: 10435 South Spaulding, Chicago
cards.notes: Check for a student or alumni exhibition, then plan a visit around the gallery’s posted access rather than assuming open studio entry.
cards.short_summary: An off-campus SXU venue for student and alumni art.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU describes the Visual Arts Center as a space showcasing student and alumni artwork with a student/alumni gallery.
cards.access_notes: Off-campus location; gallery and building access may vary by exhibition or event.

cards.title: Coffee Cats
cards.subtitle: First floor, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Use it as a Warde meet-up point or beverage stop; check current dining service before relying on the listed weekday operating window.
cards.short_summary: A campus beverage location across from The HUB.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU places Coffee Cats across from The HUB on Warde Academic Center’s first floor.
cards.access_notes: SXU lists Monday–Friday hours of 8 a.m.–3 p.m.; purchases are required for menu items.

cards.title: Country House Main Diner
cards.subtitle: First floor, Warde Academic Center
cards.notes: Plan a meal or a meeting around its published service hours; ask Dining Services directly about dietary needs and current menu availability.
cards.short_summary: The main campus dining location in Warde.
cards.evidence_claim: SXU identifies the Country House Main Diner on the first floor of the Warde Academic Center and lists breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.
cards.access_notes: SXU lists daily hours; purchases or an applicable dining plan are required for food.
